ops.title: Fleet enumeration misses cc-runtime, and cannot express nested-module consumers
ops.description:
Found 2026-08-01 by the P4.3b C1 refuter, while verifying the three off-disk legs.

`cc-runtime` is a daemonkit consumer nobody enumerated: `module github.com/yasyf/cc-runtime`,
`require github.com/yasyf/daemonkit v0.19.1` at repo root, public, unarchived, pushed the same day.
It also requires cc-interact and synckit, so it carries a cone. It was in neither the ten-on-disk
survey nor the three-off-disk P4.0 audit.

`cc-squash` (…/cc-squash/go) and `cc-skills` (…/cc-skills/plugins/codex) also require daemonkit, but
from NESTED module paths that `checkout_of` structurally cannot express — a blind spot the script
header's "Not covered, by construction" section does not name.

Third finding from the same review: the fleet set now exists in three places — `default_repos` in
scripts/fleet-build.sh, ci/fleet-refs.txt, and the matrix in .github/workflows/fleet-build.yml. Two
are cross-validated; the workflow matrix is unguarded. Preferred fix is a `--repos` flag plus a CI
assert; the refuter deliberately did not build it, on the grounds that a wrong CI assert is worse
than none.

Also noted: scripts/fleet-build.sh has zero automated coverage while five other suites drive shell
scripts. ci/mixedera/gate_test.go is the ready template.

Two narrow residuals disclosed by the same lane: `replace ( // comment` still leaks its block body
(fleet-build.sh:175), and an all-hex branch name of 7+ chars is refused as a commit SHA
(fleet-build.sh:123).

ops.text: cc-runtime has a fleet-build leg and a ci/fleet-refs.txt line
Nested-module consumers (cc-squash, cc-skills) are either expressible by checkout_of or named in the script's 'not covered, by construction' section
The workflow matrix stops being a third unguarded copy of the fleet set
